notes: ACCESS ROUTE: direct fetch throughout, no WAF/bypass needed. robots.txt checked FIRST - no Claude-specific disallow (only /cart,/checkout,/account,/search,/login and sort/filter query params); it also advertises an LLM index at /llms.txt, which was read and used to confirm the top-level catalogue shape. Site is a Next.js App Router storefront on commercetools Frontend (Frontastic) with Amplience content - the PLP product grid and its product count are rendered entirely client-side, so there is no static 'N Results' string in the HTML. CATEGORY TREE: taken from the site's own taxonomy service, not guessed - /frontastic/action/product/queryCategories on the SDK endpoint found in the JS bundle (https://storefront-solstorefront.frontastic.live/frontastic, requires a Frontastic-Locale: en_US header) returned all 4192 categories with parentId/depth/slug/showOnSite; this was cross-checked against the desktop mega-nav parsed out of the homepage HTML and against the /pages/* landing pages. In-scope roots traversed with no depth limit: CHANDELIERS & PENDANTS, BATH & WALL LIGHTS, CEILING LIGHTS, OUTDOOR LIGHTS, LAMPS & SHADES, MIRRORS & HOME DECOR. QTY VERIFICATION (Rule 1): every qty is the site's own listing total from /frontastic/action/search/productSearch?categorySlug=<slug> (the identical call the PLP makes to render its grid, page size 54), and EVERY ONE of the 73 leaf categories was then exhaustion-checked by paginating that listing to its end and counting distinct products. 69 of 73 matched the reported total exactly on the first pass; the other 4 came back exactly 1 short, and re-running all-bath-lighting under three different sort orders produced a DIFFERENT 1-2 item shortfall each time (price asc 1147, price desc 1147, newest 1148 out of 1149), proving the gap is tie-order jitter at page boundaries, not real duplication - the reported totals are exact. Note the generic /frontastic/action/product/query catalogue-wide endpoint reports total=8005 but is NOT usable for counts (unstable relevance ordering returns duplicates across offsets: 8100 fetched rows yielded only 6563 distinct products) - the per-category productSearch totals used here are a different, stable code path and were each proven by exhaustion. RULE 0 GAINS: kept the whole Bathroom Lighting branch (All Bathroom Lights 1149, Bathroom Sconces 588, Bathroom Vanity Lights 637) and Bathroom & Vanity Mirrors (123), LED Mirrors and Medicine Cabinet Mirrors despite the room word; kept Kitchen Lanterns (149), Foyer Chandeliers (301), Foyer Lanterns (230), Island & Billiard Chandeliers (148), Kids Ceiling Lights (20); kept the entire Outdoor Lights branch (All Outdoor 503, Outdoor Wall 416, Outdoor Ceiling 14, Outdoor Chandeliers 1, Outdoor Hanging 35, Outdoor Post 33, Outdoor Table & Floor Lamps 12, Dark Sky 27, Marine Grade 61) plus Outdoor Lanterns (1) under Hanging Lanterns. RULE 0.6 / ROOM TREE: the site does have a room tree (NEW & INSPIRING > SHOP BY ROOM: Bathroom 1286, Bedroom, Dining Room, Kitchen 1561, Living Room 3352, Office, Outdoor Rooms). It was DROPPED, not emitted, because sampling its actual product titles shows it is not a lighting-by-room tree at all but a whole-catalogue-by-room merchandising roll-up: shop-by-room-living-room's first page is ceramic pots, pampas grass, cheeseboards, seagrass baskets and throw pillows, and each room node also sweeps in furniture and rugs. That is a mixed roll-up ('drop, don't pad'), same call as S.N. 199 Tanagra's Shop by Room; contrast S.N. 204 Beacon Lighting, whose room tree was lighting-only and therefore emitted. OVERLAPS WITHIN WHAT IS EMITTED: 'All X' nodes are the parent category's own listing and overlap their siblings (e.g. All Chandeliers 897 covers Crystal/Drum/Flush Mount/Foyer/Glass/ Island/Mini Chandeliers; All Bathroom Lights 1149 covers Bathroom Sconces 588 + Bathroom Vanity Lights 637; All Decor 213 covers Decorative Accessories 169 + Wall Decor 42 + Wall Clocks 4); Cordless Wall Lights (13) is a strict subset of Cordless Lighting (62); Outdoor Lanterns (1) also sits inside the Outdoor Lights branch; Bathroom Sconces overlaps All Sconces. Emitted as the site presents them, not deduplicated across rows. DROPPED AS PROVEN FACET RE-CUTS (counts compared, not names - the PLP's own facet rail on each parent exposes Style / Color / Material / Size / Number of Lights): every style-named node matches its parent's Style facet bucket exactly or within a couple of items - Modern & Contemporary Chandeliers 505 = all-chandeliers Style 'Modern & Contemporary' 505, Traditional Chandeliers 186 = 186, Transitional Chandeliers 345 = 345, Modern & Contemporary Pendants 634 = 634, Rustic Pendants 115 = 115, Modern & Contemporary Lanterns 55 = 55, Nautical & Coastal Lanterns 19 = 19, Rustic Lanterns 21 = 21, Industrial Lanterns 17 = 17, Modern & Contemporary Bath Lighting 805 = 805, Industrial Sconces 112 = 112, Rustic Sconces 44 = 44, Modern & Contemporary Ceiling Lights 375 = 375, Modern & Contemporary Floor Lamps 59 = 59, Nautical & Coastal Floor Lamps 13 = 13, Modern & Contemporary Table Lamps 216 = 216, Nautical Table Lamps 30 = 30, Rustic Table Lamps 22 = 22, Industrial Table Lamps 18 = 18, Modern & Contemporary Mirrors 182 = 182, Nautical & Coastal Mirrors 47 = 47. So all Modern & Contemporary / Transitional / Traditional / Antique & Vintage Inspired / Mid Century & Retro / Rustic / Industrial / Nautical & Coastal / Minimalist / Industrial Chic nodes were dropped across every branch, as was 'Traditional Lamps & Lamp Shades' (229) and 'Traditional & Transitional Lanterns/Mirrors'. Colour nodes dropped the same way: Black Chandeliers 341 = the Color facet's 'Black' bucket 341 exactly; Colorful Table Lamps (76) and Colorful Pendants (107) dropped as colour re-cuts by the same principle (Pooky S.N. 139 precedent). KEPT DESPITE SIMILAR NAMES, because the count comparison PROVES they are not facet re-cuts: Mini Chandeliers 42 vs Size facet 'Mini less than 13"' 5; Large Pendant Lighting 165 vs Size 'Large 31" or Larger' 16; Large Ceiling Lights 146; Oversized Wall Sconces 83; Mini Table Lamps 51; Crystal Chandeliers 56 vs Material 'Crystal' 47; Glass Chandeliers 267 vs Material 'Glass' 201 - these are curated fixture categories, consistent with Pooky's kept shape/material lampshade branches. OTHER EXCLUSIONS: whole CEILING FANS root (14 nodes) and Outdoor Ceiling Fans - ceiling fans out of scope; 'Marine & Coastal Lighting and Fans' (69) dropped as a mixed lighting+fan roll-up (titles confirm ceiling fans and fan light kits inside). All 'Light Bulbs' nodes (light-bulbs, light-bulbs-1..4, and the whole LIGHT BULBS hidden header with 9 children) - bulbs. 'Chandelier Accessories' (4) dropped - two clip-on bulb adapters plus two faux drip candle bulb covers, i.e. bulb accessories. Whole FURNITURE root (20 nodes incl. Bathroom Vanity Cabinets, Bookcases, Desks, Coffee/Console/Side Tables, Stools, Dressers) and whole RUGS root (22 nodes) - furniture and textiles. Accent Pillows & Throws and Outdoor Pillows & Poufs - textiles (both also currently return 0). NEW & INSPIRING root - New Arrivals, Shop By Style, Designer Collections (Erin & Ben, Chris Loves Julia, Young House Love, Magnolia Home, Drew & Jonathan, Colonial Metalcrafts), Inspiration/blogs, Shop by Trend - all on the NEVER EXTRACT list. Every 'Clearance Sale <X>' node (11 of them) and every 'Exclusive <X>' node (7 of them) - sale and brand-exclusive listings. Every 'FEATURED' node and its FAQ/guide children. 'Shop All Hanging Lights' (2007) - a literal Shop All roll-up of Chandeliers 897 + Pendants 991 + Lanterns 182. The hidden buckets under HIDDEN (Collections with 3576 collection-name children, OTHER / Other Three / Nautical & Coastal with ~150 style, designer, rattan-material, Young House Love and seasonal/Cyber Sale re-cuts) - not part of the presented nav taxonomy, and material/style/designer re-cuts. Empty nodes dropped: Transitional Bath Lighting 0, Alabaster Sconces 0 (also showOnSite=false), CEILING LIGHTS & FIXTURES 0. SCOPE CAVEAT: Decorative Accessories (169) and therefore All Decor (213) include roughly 29 throw pillows/throws and 3 faux or preserved botanical stems that are out of scope; the site does not expose a decor listing without them (its own Accent Pillows & Throws node is empty), so the exact site figure is reported with this documented contamination rather than an estimated subtraction.
